## **Pricing and paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Pricing and paywall.**
      2 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Aug 17, 2026 - Aug 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Michael Thornber_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "They used to have a good balance between free features and premium for those who want that little bit more. The aggressive push to get people to sign up to their premium service has gone too far, putting the barcode scanner behind a paywall. I haven't used this for a few weeks and I got my mum to download the app, that's when I found out the scanner has been moved to premium. It made logging food a frustrating process for her and has since uninstalled the app. What a shame. Pure greed."
            2. _Chase Mann_, Aug 17, 2026, 4/5: "The free version is good for tracking macros. Unfortunately there are a lot of features behind a paywall and I do not believe the cost of the features is worth paying the hefty premium, but the base app works great and I would recommend it to family and friends."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      2 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Aug 17, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _D_, Aug 17, 2026, 1/5: "New version is completely broken??? Stuck on splash screen, rebooted device, cleared cache, uninstalled, reinstalled, logged in, crashed, stuck on splash screen again"
            2. _George Bower_, Aug 12, 2026, 1/5: "I used this app for years without missing a day, it was incredible, so user friendly, after the latest update it is an absolute unusable mess, if it does not return to it's former state or something resembling it they have lost my premium membership renewal"
            3. _Oliver_, Aug 5, 2026, 1/5: "I was actually always quite happy with the app. Very clear design and, apart from a few bugs when copying the diet to the next one, quite pleasant to use. But the new user interface is absolute hell. Who came up with that? Looks terrible"
<!--/ir-theme-->
